req.statement: The system shall serve GET /health/ with sub-second latency and no external dependencies required.
triggers: health responds under load-balancer probe path

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /health/ returns HTTP 2xx with sub-second latency and no external dependencies. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — normal GET returns exactly 200; (2) negative NEG — wrong method POST returns 4xx (405); (3) boundary BVA — latency must be strictly < 1000ms, tested at the threshold; (4) DT — response body structure is non-empty/valid JSON or at minimum a 2xx; (5) NEG — wrong path returns 404 not 2xx. All use FastAPI TestClient in-process, exact status code assertions, and timing checks to kill constant/comparison mutations.

trace: R-PLAYER-039: sub-second latency requirement — boundary at 1000ms
tests.executable:
import time
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_health_latency_sub_second():
    client = TestClient(app)
    start = time.monotonic()
    r = client.get('/health/')
    elapsed_ms = (time.monotonic() - start) * 1000
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert elapsed_ms < 1000, f'Latency {elapsed_ms:.1f}ms >= 1000ms threshold'

test_health_latency_sub_second()
